svg.title: The workload determines copying cost
svg.desc: Measured write amplification is 1.000 for 1000 writes to one hot sector, 3.988 for 1004 writes while keeping a block's four sectors live, and 3.951 for 4096 deterministic mixed writes across 28 sectors. These count driver calls, not storage throughput. Labels use outlined Noto Sans.

g.aria-label: Hybrid FTL: physical page writes / logical sector writes, with four pages per block.
g.title: Hybrid FTL: physical page writes / logical sector writes, with four pages per block.

g.aria-label: Driver calls measured with GNU ld --wrap; no NAND timing, fsync throughput, or cross-project speedup.
g.title: Driver calls measured with GNU ld --wrap; no NAND timing, fsync throughput, or cross-project speedup.
